# Rakitsu tested build: v0.3.2 (09c37a8e)
name: "Late shipment contact queue"
version: "1.0"
description: "Join customer delivery promises with carrier updates and produce the day\u2019s contact queue."
settings:
  default_provider: ollama
  providers:
    ollama:
      type: ollama
      base_url: http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1
      default_model: qwen3:4b-q4_K_M
  defaults:
    temperature: 0
    max_tokens: 1800
tools:
  - name: read-source
    type: fs
    operation: read
    description: Read the first bundled CSV
    allowed_paths: ["fixtures/promises.csv"]
    parameters:
      path: {type: string, required: true, enum: ["fixtures/promises.csv"]}
  - name: read-reference
    type: fs
    operation: read
    description: Read the second bundled CSV
    allowed_paths: ["fixtures/carrier.csv"]
    parameters:
      path: {type: string, required: true, enum: ["fixtures/carrier.csv"]}
  - name: save-report
    type: fs
    operation: write
    description: Save the actual Markdown report
    allowed_paths: ["output/report.md"]
    parameters:
      path: {type: string, required: true, enum: ["output/report.md"]}
      content: {type: string, required: true, description: Full Markdown report including every record}
agents:
  - name: Intake
    role: worker
    system_prompt: Read the file with the assigned tool and relay all rows verbatim.
    tools: [read-source]
    settings: {max_iterations: 4}
  - name: Reconciler
    role: worker
    system_prompt: Read the reference file with the assigned tool. Join both inputs and apply the user's policy. Account for every row.
    tools: [read-reference]
    settings: {max_iterations: 4}
  - name: Publisher
    role: worker
    system_prompt: Save the reconciled decisions as a Markdown report using save-report. Keep each ID, decision and reason. Report completion only after the tool succeeds.
    tools: [save-report]
    settings: {max_iterations: 4}
orchestrator:
  name: Reconciliation
  strategy: Pipeline
  agents: [Intake, Reconciler, Publisher]
  pipeline:
    steps:
      - name: intake
        agent: Intake
        task: "Use read-source to read fixtures/promises.csv. Return all CSV rows unchanged. /no_think"
        require_tool_call: {tool: read-source}
      - name: reconcile
        agent: Reconciler
        task: "Use read-reference to read fixtures/carrier.csv. Compare with intake and apply the user policy. Give one decision and reason per ID. /no_think"
        require_tool_call: {tool: read-reference}
      - name: publish
        agent: Publisher
        task: "Call save-report with path output/report.md and the full Markdown report. Include every decision and reason from reconcile. /no_think"
        require_tool_call: {tool: save-report}
